messages:
Tess: Two-hour pre-GA quick triage. Short checklist: SLA final wording, support runbook link, monitoring thresholds, pricing FAQ (burst/commit), and deploy gating. Who can confirm each?
Vik: SLA doc: DONE except one line on force-majeure. Legal asked for alternative phrasing. legal-bot: suggested wording posted to thread.
Jordan: Support runbook in docs, but needs explicit oncall contacts and severity mapping for token-level regressions. I can update in 30m.
Priya: Monitoring: p90 latency alert and error-rate alert need concrete thresholds. Current proposal: p90 > 900ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.8% for 5m. Thoughts?
Vik: That sounds reasonable. Add a throttling-safety alert: queued_requests > 500 for 2m.
Jordan: Adding contacts + severity mapping. Also adding a short rollback checklist with commands so oncall can act fast.
Tess: Please paste rollback commands here after you add them. We need copy/paste.
Jordan: Rollback snippet:
```
# rollback to last known-good
redwoodctl deploy promote --version v2026-03-19-03
redwoodctl rollout abort --id $CURRENT_ROLLOUT
```
Also checklist: notify oncall -> abort rollout -> promote LKG -> verify smoke.
Priya: Pricing FAQ: I'll draft two bullets: (1) burst autoscale billing behavior and (2) committed capacity discount ramp. Will drop PR in docs in ~45m.
Vik: Legal: can you confirm the SLO exception phrasing so we can ship SLA doc?
legal-bot: Proposed SLO exception text: "Service credit exceptions may be applied for events outside Redwood's reasonable control; eligibility requires timely incident report and mitigation steps." Approve/modify.
Priya: That works - I approve.
Tess: Deploy gating: canary scheduled by deploy-bot for 2026-03-21T22:30Z but we will only flip after this thread confirms all items done. deploy-bot: canary scheduled.
sre-bot: Note: planned infra maintenance window 2026-03-22T01:00Z - may overlap with early GA telemetry, advise caution.
Jordan: Support runbook PR: /docs/runbooks/ga-lite-runbook.md - added contacts and severity mapping. Link in docs repo.
Vik: SLA doc updated with legal phrasing and uploaded to /docs/sla/ga-sla-v1.md
Priya: Owners recap: Vik -> SLA + legal; Jordan -> runbook + rollback; Priya -> pricing FAQ PR; Tess -> final GO decision. If no red flags by 12:30pm PT, I give manual GO. Flag blockers with :rotating_light:.
Tess: Thanks team. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
